name: Reply 1988
description: Take a nostalgic trip back to the late 1980s through the lives of five families and their five teenage kids living in a small neighbourhood in Seoul.

videos.title: 10th Anniversary Reunion (I): The Reunion of Ssangmun-Dong Families
videos.overview: Despite their busy schedule, the five families of Ssangmun-dong gather together to reminisce about the drama "Reply 1988" from 10 years ago. As if going on a time travel, the actors appear wearing the exact same outfits from the drama. Before the retreat, they first gather by family in Gapyeong and start the opening at three different locations. Trapped in 1988, they play fun games to get their money for lunch. As each family experiences unexpected reactions and twists, they show off their amazing teamwork and chemistry. They also tell touching behind-the-scenes stories and introduce their favorite items related to the drama. What memories and emotions will their reunion bring back? Stay tuned to find out!

videos.title: 10th Anniversary Reunion (II): The Five Ssangmun-Dong Families' Fun Trip to Goseong
videos.overview: After the allowance game, the five families of Ssangmun-dong gather at a rest stop and share a meal, reminiscing about the Ssangmuin-dong scenes from the drama ten years ago. Upon arriving at their Goseong lodging, they reflect on the 10th anniversary by taking a poster photo again. The highlight is undoubtedly Family Entertainment, where the families split into three teams and compete for the Hoeingseong Korean beef set. The first round, Speed Quiz, involves guessing names of food, places, and people. Jae Hong brings laughter to everyone as he explains Tchaikovsky. The second round features the Music Scholarship Quiz, with questions based on age and score. Bo Gum's unexpected answers and Hye Ri's continuous dance elicit laughter from everyone. After the fun games, they renew their teamwork by enjoying a barbecue dinner. How will the night of the reminiscent trip go? Stay tuned to find out!

videos.title: 10th Anniversary Reunion (III): The Last Member of Ssangmun-dong
videos.overview: Here comes Special Mission, Ssangmun-dong Dads' Challenge! Four Ssangmun-dong dads, Dong Il, Moo Sung, Jae Myung, and Sung Kyun, will take on a challenge for the prizes.  Meanwhile, Kim Seol, who played Jin Ju in Reply 1988, the last member of Ssangmun-dong, appears suddenly and surprises everyone.

videos.title: Hand in Hand
videos.overview: In 1988 Seoul, Deok-sun spends her days hanging out with childhood friends and practicing her role in the upcoming Olympics opening ceremony.

videos.title: One Thing You Misunderstood About Me
videos.overview: Choi Taek's latest win calls for a neighborhood celebration. Deok-sun and Dong-il grieve for their loved one's passing in different ways.

videos.title: The Rich are Innocent, and the Poor are Guilty
videos.overview: Despite her disastrous dance skills, Deok-sun is determined to win a cassette player at a talent show being held during her school retreat.

videos.title: Can't Help~ing
videos.overview: Deok-sun declares she wants to get into college, Seong-gyun nurses hurt feelings, and Taek deals poorly with losing.

videos.title: Preparing for Winter
videos.overview: Bo-ra's participation in risky student protests upsets Dong-il. Sun-young wants to show her mother she's doing all right, even when she isn't.

videos.title: The First Snow is Falling
videos.overview: Taek shoulders heavy pressure as he heads to China for a tournament. Deok-sun writes about experiencing first love, which Jung-hwan happens to read.

videos.title: To That Person
videos.overview: With Christmas around the corner, everyone picks names for Secret Santa. Jung-hwan notices Deok-sun wants a pair of pink mittens.

videos.title: One Warm Remark
videos.overview: While the Kim family braces for Jung-bong's heart surgery, Bo-ra runs into relationship trouble, and Deok-sun meets No-eul's girlfriend.

videos.title: What it Means to Cross the Line
videos.overview: The new year comes with money trouble for Sun-young and a health scare for Moo-sung. Deok-sun gets a glimpse of Taek's life in the spotlight.

videos.title: Memory
videos.overview: Everyone piles into Bo-ra's car to fetch Dong-ryong after he runs away from home on his birthday. Deok-sun and Taek take a detour on the way back.

videos.title: Three Prophecies
videos.overview: The moms see a fortuneteller. Jung-hwan grapples with complicated feelings, made worse when Deok-sun and her family temporarily move into his house.

videos.title: What It Means To Love Someone
videos.overview: Secrets abound as Sun-young keeps news about her part-time job from Sun-woo, who sneaks around with Bo-ra. Moo-sung babysits.

videos.title: Superman is Back
videos.overview: Il-hwa gets anxious about a lump on her chest before a physical at the hospital. Taek leaves for a big competition in Tokyo.

videos.title: Don't You Worry
videos.overview: Sun-woo doesn't like that Sun-young and Moo-sung have grown so close. Deok-sun gifts Jung-hwan a pink shirt for his birthday.

videos.title: Between Love and Friendship
videos.overview: Deok-sun faces a harsh reality check about getting into college. Dong-ryong ends up at the police station. Seong-gyun takes a bad fall.

videos.title: Life is an Irony (1)
videos.overview: When a TV singing competition rolls into town, Mi-ran and Dong-ryong are eager to audition. Bo-ra moves out to study for the bar exam.

videos.title: Life is an Irony (2)
videos.overview: As Deok-sun and the boys ponder their futures, the parents discuss their own bygone dreams. Meanwhile, Taek dreams of something sweeter.

videos.title: Goodbye, My First Love
videos.overview: It's 1994, and the friends are back in town for Taek's birthday. Deok-sun gets stood up for a concert, and Bo-ra agrees to a blind date.

videos.title: You Did Your Very Best
videos.overview: During a layover in Beijing, Deok-sun makes sure to stop by to take care of Taek. Jung-hwan puts together a touching surprise for Mi-ran.

videos.title: Goodbye, My Youth. Goodbye, Ssangmundong.
videos.overview: While Sun-woo and Bo-ra set out to change their parents' minds about their relationship, juicy gossip about Taek turns up on the news.
